answer: Whether agents trade ferrous scrap, commission a sonnet, or buy pulse data, the marketplace requires each identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding, and permits only one active bid per bond. Creating more names gives no extra bidding capacity without more collateral. An attacker running 10,000 identities must immobilize $1 million for a month, paying financing costs and losing access to that capital throughout the lockup.
